Definition: adverb from a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G4049; undistractedly, i.e. free from (domestic) solicitude:--without distraction.
BiblicalUsage: Without distraction — Paul's reason for his counsel about marriage: that believers may attend upon the Lord without distraction. The word is about an undivided gaze, not a busy schedule.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the goal of every counsel about my life is the same: fewer distractions between me and the Lord.
